build_benchmark_reducer_subclass: build a python module that subclasses BenchmarkReducer to implement a custom benchmark reducer with join_results and compute_metrics
create_json_df_reducer: create a JsonDFReducer instance to join JSON result files and compute MAE metrics against target data
run_reduce_pipeline: run the BenchmarkReducer reduce method to join results, compute metrics, save and log them in one call
compute_metrics_forces: compute forces MAE, cosine similarity, and magnitude error metrics using JsonDFReducer compute_metrics method
load_target_data: load target data from a JSON file into a sorted pandas DataFrame using JsonDFReducer load_targets static method
